verdict.rationale: Linear's GraphQL API supports introspection, so the whole schema can be queried in machine-readable form. That is a GraphQL equivalent of an OpenAPI spec, and the API is also explorable publicly via Apollo Studio. The evidence is first-party docs only. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented downloadable schema file (SDL/JSON) or published spec URL, and independent or hands-on corroboration of retrieving the schema.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
Our GraphQL API is explorable and queryable via [Apollo Studio](https://studio.apollographql.com/public/Linear-API/variant/current/home), no download or log in required.
